applicability.other_apps: not applicable; the base IK visualization contract remains unchanged

channels.semantics: The left Cartesian planner sample most recently submitted to Red, whether Red accepted or rejected it.
The right Cartesian planner sample most recently submitted to Red, whether Red accepted or rejected it.

coherence.attempt: The left and right messages describe the same staged planner sample submitted in one Red attempt.
coherence.retention: If planning fails before a sample is submitted to Red, both channels retain the previous valid planning request.
coherence.timestamp: Both messages use the same emit timestamp as the base IK visualization update.
coherence.pose_reference_frame: Each PoseInFrame carries the robot model reference frame used by Red.
